title: Photography / Tips and techniques

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Choose viewpoint, focus and treatment deliberately so photographs reveal useful context rather than manufacture drama.
strategic_value: Eye-level and aerial views, sharp detail and natural lighting can make IBM imagery feel observant and consistent with its fact-based voice.
demonstration: The webpage compares photographic viewpoints, gridded framing and focal points, aspect ratios, lighting, depth of field, artificial effects and clichés, with rejected examples marked in red.
practical_value: Evaluate a photograph against concrete criteria for viewpoint, framing, light and authenticity before selecting or commissioning it.

content_islands.name: Perspective
content_islands.spec: Begin with eye-level and aerial examples, then place rejected forced viewpoints underneath.

content_islands.name: Composition
content_islands.spec: Pair photographs with rectangular grid diagrams showing framing and focal positions; keep the failed focal-point comparisons below.

content_islands.name: Aspect ratios
content_islands.spec: Place the black ratio diagram between composition and lighting; it labels standard crop proportions.

content_islands.name: Lighting and depth
content_islands.spec: Pair a large example for each topic with smaller rejected images, distinguishing natural light and broad sharpness from stylized lighting or shallow focus.

content_islands.name: Effects and clichés
content_islands.spec: Finish with red-marked artificial treatments and stock metaphors, keeping the explanatory copy with each pair.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text connects eye-level views to equality, sharpness to context and detail, and restrained treatment to IBM’s fact-based communication.
reference_purposes.Expression: Editorial photographs and gridded overlays demonstrate IBM’s preferred natural, contextual image treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: The guidance supplies framing, focal-point and crop decisions, including 16:9, 4:3, 3:2, 2:1 or 1:1 unless a format specifies otherwise.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source rejects forced perspectives, soft focus, color washes, overlays and artificial additions; natural light is preferred whenever possible.

ingredient.name: Photographic viewpoint and treatment
ingredient.role: Present work and people with clear context.
ingredient.application: Use natural eye-level or overhead viewpoints, clear focal points and sharp contextual detail; choose a listed crop ratio unless the format specifies otherwise.
ingredient.scope: IBM photography selection and creation guidance. Natural light is qualified as whenever possible, while listed rejection examples establish specific unwanted treatments.
